members.name: variant_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which single intent best describes what the customer is asking about or reporting? Pick the most specific matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card the customer has received, or activation problems.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; can children/teens have accounts.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets with the card; adding the card to a wallet, top up via Apple/Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, using the card at ATMs in general (not a specific failed or wrong withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, how it works, turning it off.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.definition: The customer has already made a bank transfer (typically from their own account elsewhere, e.g. a UK bank account, into this account) and it has not shown up yet, or the balance is slow to update after it.
includes: the transfer doesn't appear / isn't showing / doesn't seem to be working after the customer just made it, even when they also ask how long such transfers normally take
why is it taking so long to update my balance after a transfer
examples: Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?
How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it doesn't seem to be working
excludes: the customer says they deposited money or put money into the account without mentioning a transfer (balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit)

criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited money, a cheque or cash (or says they put money into their account) and it is not yet showing in the balance / when will my deposit show up. Use this when the customer speaks of a deposit without mentioning a transfer or top-up.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee/recipient, the beneficiary is not allowed or rejected, or trouble transferring money to a beneficiary.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: General questions about where the card is accepted: which shops, merchants, businesses or countries accept the card; will it work everywhere. Not a specific payment that was refused (declined_card_payment).
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery; card still not received after waiting.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a new card will arrive (before it's overdue), express delivery, delivery options.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account / app, re-adding a card that was found, linking an existing card in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The customer thinks something is wrong with the card itself: it stopped working, is broken or damaged, or keeps failing everywhere / in several different places (not just one declined payment, ATM, contactless or virtual card).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra charge for using the card to pay: charged extra for using my card, fees on card payments/purchases; why do my payments have fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment the customer doesn't recognise or says they didn't make, appearing in the app/statement.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment/purchase abroad or in foreign currency.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make.
criteria.change_pin: How to change, update or set a new PIN (customer already has a PIN or wants a different one); where PIN changes can be made. Not: PIN not received or can't be found (that is get_physical_card).
criteria.compromised_card: Card may be compromised / used fraudulently / details stolen, someone else may be using the card, suspected fraud on the card (card itself still in possession).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in / supported countries; can I use the account or open it in a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined, rejected, refused or not accepted, or the card didn't work when the customer tried to pay in a shop, restaurant, online or with a merchant; why was my payment declined.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM declined the cash withdrawal; unable to withdraw cash.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected / blocked; told a transfer is not possible.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many times usable, how many can be created.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details: name, address, phone number, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees for currency exchange; charge for exchanging money.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / where rates come from / current exchange rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; can I exchange to a currency; holding multiple currencies.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific unexplained extra amount or charge showing on the account or statement (e.g. 'why has my card been charged an extra pound?', 'what is this extra €1 fee?'), not tied to a purchase, ATM withdrawal, transfer or top-up.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer or a large payment made by transfer (e.g. a payment for a flat or mortgage) failed / gives an error / didn't go through / bounced back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/exchanging/paying; can I use a specific currency.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card and the things that come with it: the card PIN has not arrived / customer hasn't received or can't find their PIN / where do I get my PIN; where to find or how to get the physical card; I have a virtual card and want the plastic one.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/second/spare card, cards for family members.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get, order or find a virtual card (e.g. where to locate the virtual card in the app), cost of a virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, can't find card, report it lost/stolen, freeze/block it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; can't access app because phone is gone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card, cost of a card, card delivery to a country.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode; locked out of the app.
criteria.pending_card_payment: The customer's payment (a card payment or purchase) is pending, showing as pending, hasn't posted or hasn't gone through yet; when will my payment go through / post. A pending item the customer calls a payment belongs here.
criteria.pending_top_up: Customer says they topped up (a top-up) but the top-up money hasn't appeared in the balance yet / top-up still processing or pending. Only when a top-up is mentioned, not deposits or transfers.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer, or a transaction expected to arrive in the account, is pending / still processing / not yet cleared or posted (e.g. 'when will the transaction post to my account?', 'why is my pending transaction taking so long to post as cleared?'); not a pending payment or purchase.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked/locked after too many wrong attempts; unblock the PIN or card.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money into the account: getting paid, salary, payments from others; can my salary be paid here; questions about being paid in a currency.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to get a refund or return; how to request a refund for an item/purchase.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled; money came back unexpectedly.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards/card types and currencies are supported for topping up or payments; can I top up with a particular card.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up via bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / adding money with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up failed, was declined, or didn't work.
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up was reverted / cancelled / money returned after topping up; top-up disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a debit/credit card; card top-up issues such as money taken from the card but the top-up not showing.

examples: I have used this account overseas recently. Has there been an increase in fees that I am unaware of?

criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my account / add money by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient hasn't received a transfer the customer sent.

transfer_timing.definition: How long transfers take to arrive, or how much longer the customer must wait for a transfer (e.g. a transfer from the US or Europe).
excludes: the customer just made a transfer into their account and it isn't showing in the balance (balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer)
examples: How long does a transfer from Europe take?
I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?

criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but failing / verification not working / can't verify.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code for a top-up by card; verifying a top-up card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Card network: is the card Visa or Mastercard; wanting or asking for a card of a specific network (e.g. 'I want a Visa card', 'can I get a Mastercard').
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.
